entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗为霍尔木兹重新开放列出条件，航运走廊仍待落实
Reuters 8月27日报道，伊朗称已与阿曼就海峡航运走廊达成框架，但要求美国解除封锁、赔偿并取消制裁；停火安排此前两度未能维持。事实是通航谈判存在，判断是油价风险溢价仍难完全退出，执行条件具有高度不确定性。
国际
地区斡旋寻求停火出口，油轮遇袭与加沙冲突维持尾部风险
AP 8月27日报道，卡塔尔等地区力量继续寻求结束伊朗战争，同时霍尔木兹附近再报油轮袭击，以色列对加沙和黎巴嫩的行动仍在持续。能源、航运和避险资产可能继续对突发消息敏感。
科技
行业榜软件、半导体与白银领涨，消费链居末
Moomoo完整145行业榜显示应用软件+5.23%（CRM +22.58%）、健康信息服务+5.04%、半导体+4.43%（NVDA +8.74%）、焦炭+4.03%、白银+3.83%；纺织制造-12.18%、奢侈品-4.47%、杂货店-2.97%居末。A/H映射偏向软件、算力、芯片和贵金属，消费与出口链需防弱势扩散。
科技
Sparks网络安全、IDC与CPU走强，可靠负榜以压力样本补足
Sparks正数Top5为SOL储备+13.28%、网络安全+7.98%（OKTA +28.63%）、IDC +6.94%、CPU +6.83%、加密储备+6.49%；光通信另涨2.97%、AI PC涨3.02%。负收益区未可靠加载，面板仅以KWEB、XLY、JETS、XHB、XRT样本补足并明确披露，不能据此推断完整概念广度。
科技
芯片现金时段强势，但夜盘NVDA与SMH转跌
隔夜半导体行业+4.43%，NVDA现金时段+8.74%；08:24 CST夜盘NVDA -0.758%、SMH代理-0.729%，形成潜在反转。A/H芯片、光模块、服务器与PCB若高开但前30分钟不能放量守住，应优先控制追高风险。
科技
应用软件与网络安全大涨，夜盘动能开始收敛
应用软件行业+5.23%，CRM +22.58%；Sparks网络安全+7.98%，OKTA +28.63%。夜盘CRM仅+0.119%、OKTA -0.242%，由强确认转为背离/潜在反转；A/H软件、云服务和网络安全需以开盘相对恒生科技与创业板的强度验证。
财报
中国人寿利润与新业务价值高增，保险板块获本地支点
公司8月27日披露上半年总保费5366.34亿元、归母净利润1344.89亿元，同比+228.6%，新业务价值381.67亿元、同比+33.7%；Futu日历营收5366.34亿元高于约5308.12亿元预测。H股此前收29.32港元、+0.41%，正式开盘价格反馈仍待确认。
财报
哔哩哔哩盈利继续改善，美股价格先行确认
B站二季度营收79.4亿元、同比+8%，净利润3.39亿元，经调整净利润7亿元、同比+25%；上半年净利润5.41亿元、同比+160.6%。BILI现金时段+3.81%，夜盘-0.029%近持平；09626.HK需验证能否放量突破前收。
财报
海尔智家收入与利润同比下滑，汇率拖累需重新定价
海尔智家上半年营收1521.15亿元、同比-2.8%，归母净利润103.16亿元、同比-14.27%，扣非净利润同比-20.54%；Futu日历收入与EPS字段高于其一致预期，但同比趋势偏弱。H股此前收21.42港元、-0.46%，财报后开盘若继续弱于家电板块则不宜抢反弹。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
夜盘指数
Futu OpenD运行时夜盘代理快照：QQQ -0.120%、SPY -0.070%、DIA +0.005%；行情为2026-08-27美东夜盘实时字段，抓取时间2026-08-28 08:24 CST。三者均为ETF代理，不表述为指数期货。
对照
板块对照
行业逐项：应用软件/CRM +0.119%确认；健康信息/ZCMD -3.103%、半导体/NVDA -0.758%为潜在反转；焦炭/METC、白银/AYA及广播/BBGI、赌场/BALY、杂货/VHUB、奢侈/BRLT、纺织/AIN均夜盘不可得。概念逐项：SOL/HSDT 0.000%为背离；网络安全/OKTA -0.242%、IDC与CPU共用NVDA -0.758%、加密储备/PPCB -16.591%均为潜在反转；压力样本KWEB +0.191%为潜在反转，XLY、JETS、XHB、XRT不可得。重复NVDA只抓取一次复用。
映射
A/H 映射
隔夜软件、芯片和白银强势对A/H仍是正向底稿，但QQQ、NVDA、SMH、GLD与SLV夜盘均转弱，短线采用“现金强、夜盘降温”的谨慎信号。开盘验证为恒生科技/创业板能否守住前收、芯片和软件成交是否放大、贵金属是否强于大盘；若高开后30分钟失守前收则映射失效。

盘前结论

事实：Moomoo完整行业榜显示应用软件、半导体与白银显著领涨，Sparks网络安全、IDC与CPU同步强势；中国人寿和B站披露了可验证的本地业绩改善。但消费链行业广度偏弱，Sparks负收益区只能以压力样本降级补足。

判断：A/H基准情景是软件、国产算力、芯片与贵金属先获映射，保险和B站获得财报支点。QQQ、NVDA、SMH、GLD与SLV夜盘反向，短线优先采用夜盘降温信号，不追隔夜涨幅。

不确定性：霍尔木兹谈判与冲突并存，完整Sparks负榜缺失；只有恒生科技/创业板守住前收且科技成交放大，或贵金属相对大盘继续走强，才把观察升级为顺势交易。

应用软件半导体网络安全白银中国人寿B站盈利IDCCPU霍尔木兹消费压力本地财报夜盘降温

重点个股推荐

中国人寿
02628
业绩支点

推荐理由：上半年归母净利润同比+228.6%、新业务价值+33.7%，营收高于Futu日历预测，保险板块获得明确本地催化。

触发因素：开盘放量站上29.32港元前收并强于恒指金融板块。

风险点：利润受投资收益推动，权益市场和利率回撤会削弱持续性；未确认价格前不追高。

哔哩哔哩-W
09626
盈利改善

推荐理由：二季度营收同比+8%、经调整净利润同比+25%，BILI现金时段上涨3.81%，形成可验证正反馈。

触发因素：港股开盘守住129.7港元前收并放量，且强于恒生科技。

风险点：营收增速已降至个位数，夜盘近持平；若高开低走则降级为观察。

中芯国际
00981
芯片映射

推荐理由：美股半导体行业+4.43%、NVDA +8.74%，A/H先进制程与国产算力有直接映射。

触发因素：开盘强于恒生科技并放量，且前30分钟不跌回前收。

风险点：NVDA与SMH夜盘分别-0.758%和-0.729%，海外强势已出现潜在反转。

紫金矿业
02899
贵金属映射

推荐理由：Moomoo完整榜中白银+3.83%、其他贵金属+1.40%、黄金+0.82%，资源映射具有行业广度。

触发因素：金银矿股开盘相对恒指走强，且现货/ETF价格不继续回落。

风险点：GLD与SLV夜盘分别-0.307%和-0.430%，若贵金属低开则现金时段利好失效。

板块轮动看板

受益方向软件、网络安全、国产算力、半导体、白银与黄金；行业榜和Sparks现金时段共同支持，但夜盘降温要求量价确认。
观察方向保险、视频平台与消费电子；中国人寿、B站和海尔业绩分化，优先跟随正式开盘价格反馈。
压力方向纺织、奢侈品、杂货、零售及高估值科技追涨；行业负榜与夜盘反转共同限制风险偏好。
验证信号恒生科技/创业板守前收、芯片软件放量、贵金属强于大盘、02628与09626业绩后价格方向。

逻辑链

隔夜应用软件、半导体、白银与Sparks网络安全/IDC/CPU领涨，确认AI基础设施向软件和资源扩散。
海外强势映射A/H国产算力、芯片、云软件、贵金属，同时本地中国人寿与B站业绩提供独立支点。
运行时QQQ、NVDA、SMH、GLD与SLV转弱，说明现金涨幅进入兑现窗口，不能机械外推。
因此交易只在开盘守前收、相对指数走强且成交放大时成立；高开低走或贵金属继续回落即失效。

风险雷达

夜盘反转

QQQ、NVDA、SMH、GLD与SLV均转弱，海外现金时段强势可能在A/H开盘前降温。

Sparks负榜缺口

可靠负收益区未完整加载，补足样本只能提示压力，不能代表完整概念排序与广度。

霍尔木兹执行风险

航运走廊仍附带制裁、赔偿等条件，新袭击可迅速推升油价和避险需求。

财报价格背离

海尔同比下滑，中国人寿利润含投资收益弹性，B站增速放缓，headline与股价可能背离。

高开兑现

软件、芯片和网络安全隔夜涨幅较大，A/H若缩量高开，获利回吐风险高。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（完整5页/145行业，重点复核黄金、其他贵金属、白银、铜、半导体）；Futunn Sparks首选页一次解析及Futu同BK成分现金快照；Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ财报日历、四组NOTICE检索、股票快照与夜盘字段；Reuters、AP、中国人寿公告、哔哩哔哩业绩、海尔智家半年报。行业/概念现金行情为2026-08-27美东收盘；夜盘行情时间为2026-08-27美东夜盘，抓取时间2026-08-28 08:24 CST；页面更新时间2026-08-28 08:26 CST。Sparks可靠负收益区未加载，已明确使用5个ETF压力样本；ETF均为代理。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Global
Iran sets terms for reopening Hormuz while the shipping corridor remains conditional
Reuters reported on Aug. 27 that Iran and Oman had a framework for a Strait shipping corridor, but Tehran demanded that the US lift its blockade, pay compensation and remove sanctions; two prior ceasefire arrangements failed. Negotiations are factual, but execution remains highly uncertain and the oil risk premium may persist.
Global
Regional mediation seeks an off-ramp as tanker attacks and Gaza fighting sustain tail risk
AP reported on Aug. 27 that Qatar and other regional powers kept seeking an end to the Iran war while another tanker attack was reported near Hormuz and Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon continued. Energy, shipping and havens remain sensitive to sudden headlines.
Tech
Software, semiconductors and silver led the industry table while consumer groups lagged
Moomoo's complete 145-industry table showed application software +5.23% (CRM +22.58%), health information services +5.04%, semiconductors +4.43% (NVDA +8.74%), coking coal +4.03% and silver +3.83%. Textile manufacturing -12.18%, luxury goods -4.47% and grocery stores -2.97% were the weakest. A/H mappings favor software, compute, chips and precious metals, while consumer and export chains face spillover risk.
Tech
Sparks cybersecurity, data centers and CPUs strengthened; verified pressure samples fill the unreliable negative range
Sparks' positive Top5 were SOL reserve +13.28%, cybersecurity +7.98% (OKTA +28.63%), data center +6.94%, CPU +6.83% and crypto treasury +6.49%; optical communication rose 2.97% and AI PC 3.02%. The negative range did not load reliably, so only disclosed KWEB, XLY, JETS, XHB and XRT samples fill the panel and do not represent complete concept breadth.
Tech
Chip strength in cash trading faded as NVDA and SMH turned lower overnight
The semiconductor industry gained 4.43% and NVDA rose 8.74% in cash trading; at 08:24 CST, NVDA was -0.758% and the SMH proxy -0.729% overnight, a potential reversal. If A/H chips, optical modules, servers and PCBs gap up but cannot hold on rising volume in the first 30 minutes, chasing risk takes priority.
Tech
Application software and cybersecurity surged, but overnight momentum narrowed
Application software gained 5.23% with CRM +22.58%; Sparks cybersecurity rose 7.98% with OKTA +28.63%. Overnight CRM was only +0.119% and OKTA -0.242%, shifting from strong confirmation toward divergence or potential reversal. A/H software, cloud and security need opening relative strength versus HSTECH and ChiNext.
Earnings
China Life's profit and new-business value surged, adding a local insurance anchor
China Life reported first-half gross written premiums of RMB536.63bn, attributable profit of RMB134.49bn, up 228.6%, and new-business value of RMB38.17bn, up 33.7%. Futu's calendar showed revenue above the roughly RMB530.81bn estimate. The H share previously closed at HKD29.32, +0.41%; post-results opening feedback is still pending.
Earnings
Bilibili extended its profit improvement and the US listing confirmed the result
Bilibili posted Q2 revenue of RMB7.94bn, up 8%, net income of RMB339m and adjusted net income of RMB700m, up 25%; first-half net income rose 160.6% to RMB541m. BILI gained 3.81% in cash trading and was nearly flat overnight at -0.029%; 09626.HK must confirm by breaking above its prior close on volume.
Earnings
Haier Smart Home's revenue and profit declined as FX drag requires repricing
Haier Smart Home reported first-half revenue of RMB152.12bn, down 2.8%, attributable profit of RMB10.32bn, down 14.27%, and adjusted profit down 20.54%. Futu calendar revenue and EPS fields exceeded its consensus, but the year-on-year trend was weak. The H share previously closed at HKD21.42, -0.46%; continued underperformance versus appliances would argue against bottom-fishing.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight
Overnight Indexes
Futu OpenD runtime overnight proxy snapshot: QQQ -0.120%, SPY -0.070% and DIA +0.005%. The fields were live for the Aug. 27 New York overnight session and captured at 08:24 CST on Aug. 28. All three are ETF proxies, not index futures.
Cross-check
Panel Cross-check
Industry rows: application software/CRM +0.119% confirmed; health information/ZCMD -3.103% and semiconductors/NVDA -0.758% were potential reversals; overnight data were unavailable for coking coal/METC, silver/AYA, broadcasting/BBGI, casinos/BALY, groceries/VHUB, luxury/BRLT and textiles/AIN. Concept rows: SOL/HSDT 0.000% diverged; cybersecurity/OKTA -0.242%, data center and CPU sharing NVDA -0.758%, and crypto treasury/PPCB -16.591% were potential reversals; pressure sample KWEB +0.191% was a potential reversal, while XLY, JETS, XHB and XRT were unavailable. The duplicate NVDA quote was fetched once and reused.
Mapping
A/H Mapping
Cash-session strength in software, chips and silver remains a positive base for A/H, but QQQ, NVDA, SMH, GLD and SLV all turned lower overnight, so the short-term signal is cautiously 'strong cash, cooling overnight.' Validate whether HSTECH and ChiNext hold prior closes, chip and software turnover expands, and precious metals outperform; a loss of prior close within 30 minutes after a gap-up invalidates the mapping.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: Moomoo's complete industry table showed application software, semiconductors and silver leading, while Sparks cybersecurity, data centers and CPUs strengthened; China Life and Bilibili delivered verifiable local earnings improvement.Consumer-industry breadth was weak, while Sparks negatives required disclosed pressure-sample supplementation.

View: the A/H base case gives the first mapping to software, domestic compute, chips and precious metals, with earnings anchors in insurance and Bilibili.QQQ, NVDA, SMH, GLD and SLV reversed overnight, so cooling overnight momentum takes precedence over chasing cash-session gains.

Uncertainty: Hormuz talks coexist with conflict and the complete Sparks negative range is missing. Upgrade observation only if HSTECH/ChiNext hold prior closes with expanding tech turnover or precious metals keep outperforming.

Trigger: gold and silver miners outperform the Hang Seng while spot or ETF prices stop weakening.

Risk: GLD and SLV fell 0.307% and 0.430% overnight; a weak open invalidates the cash-session tailwind.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesSoftware, cybersecurity, domestic compute, semiconductors, silver and gold; cash-session industry and Sparks signals agree, but overnight cooling requires price-volume confirmation.
WatchInsurance, video platforms and consumer electronics; China Life, Bilibili and Haier results diverged, so follow actual opening price feedback.
PressureTextiles, luxury, groceries, retail and chasing expensive tech; industry laggards and overnight reversals jointly limit risk appetite.
ValidationHSTECH/ChiNext holding prior closes, chip and software volume expansion, metals outperforming, and post-results direction in 02628 and 09626.

Logic Chain

Application software, semiconductors and silver led alongside Sparks cybersecurity, data centers and CPUs, confirming AI infrastructure spillover into software and resources.
That strength maps to A/H domestic compute, chips, cloud software and precious metals, while China Life and Bilibili earnings provide independent local anchors.
Runtime QQQ, NVDA, SMH, GLD and SLV turned lower, showing that cash-session gains entered a realization window and cannot be extrapolated mechanically.
A trade therefore requires holding prior close, relative outperformance and expanding turnover; a gap-and-fade or further metals weakness invalidates it.

Risk Radar

Overnight reversal

QQQ, NVDA, SMH, GLD and SLV all weakened, so US cash-session strength may cool before the A/H open.

Sparks negative gap

The reliable negative range did not fully load; supplemental samples signal pressure but cannot represent complete concept order or breadth.

Hormuz execution risk

The shipping corridor remains conditional on sanctions and compensation, while another attack could quickly lift oil and haven demand.

Earnings-price divergence
